description: The `D_ICD_DIAGNOSES` table provides a dictionary of ICD-9 diagnosis codes. It contains the ICD-9 code itself, along with short and long descriptive titles associated with each code. This table is useful for translating numeric ICD-9 codes into human-readable descriptions.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: ICD9_CODE
columns.description: ICD-9 code representing a diagnosis or procedure performed on a patient.

columns.name: SHORT_TITLE
columns.description: A short, descriptive title corresponding to the ICD-9 code. It provides a concise label for the diagnosis or procedure.

columns.name: LONG_TITLE
columns.description: A longer, more detailed title corresponding to the ICD-9 code, offering a comprehensive description of the diagnosis or procedure.
